computationUniverse.expansion: Reconstruct each computation from taskFamilies.population and packages.

defaultAssessment.selector: every computation x every reuse layer x every applicable environment profile
defaultAssessment.reason: Configuration posture and prior cache hits are not qualification evidence.

layerPolicies.reason: A required job must start and publish its own exact-head or merge-ref status; only pure prerequisites may be reused.

layerPolicies.selector: the cache directory as a transport pool, never an individual computation verdict
layerPolicies.reason: Restoration can improve availability but Turbo must independently accept every entry by task hash.
These lanes depend on live advisory or security observations and are already excluded by source policy.

familySeeds.reason: Currently reused without a durable per-computation qualification record.
A result artifact and Turbo hash seam exist, but ProofLedger adoption belongs to time-to-certainty.
Concurrent jobs have destructively shared report state; qualify pure shards separately from aggregation and verdicts.
External services, secrets, containers, browsers, concurrency, and live verdicts require decomposition before reuse.
The current commands mutate source or generated state. A separate check/projection computation may be assessed.
Persistent services are not finite task-result computations.
No workspace defines an executable transit script at this snapshot.

requiredEvidence: independent perturbation of every semantic input class
declared output and terminal-log observational equivalence
supported runner and toolchain profile parity
genuine remote-hit wire receipt distinct from Actions archive restoration
exact stable client and isolated exact canary client results

transitionAuthority.requiredReceipt: versioned evidence bundle plus reviewer decision
transitionAuthority.failClosedRule: Any unexplained divergence, missing required input, unsafe log, or environment escape moves the assessment to excluded or suspended.
